title: Crash on startup when config.yaml is missing
body: Deleting config.yaml and launching widget-factory 4.2.0 crashes immediately with a FileNotFoundError traceback instead of creating a default config. Windows 11, Python 3.11.

comments.body: Reproduced on 4.2.0. Regression from the config loader rewrite.

title: App crashes at launch if the config file was deleted
body: Fresh install, removed the config to reset settings, app now won't start at all. No error dialog, just closes. macOS 15.

title: Silent wrong totals in CSV export when locale uses comma decimals
body: Exporting the monthly report on a German-locale machine writes 1,5 instead of 1.5 and downstream tools read it as 15. No error is raised — the numbers are just wrong. Affects every locale that uses comma decimal separators.

comments.body: This bit us too — quarterly numbers were off by 10x in two cells and nobody noticed for a month.

title: Feature request: dark mode
body: Would love a dark theme for the dashboard. Happy to contribute if pointed at the theming code.

title: Docs: quickstart missing Windows steps
body: The quickstart only covers macOS/Linux. Windows users need the venv activation and PATH steps spelled out.

title: Data loss: saving a project to a network share truncates the file
body: Saving to an SMB share writes a 0-byte file about 1 in 5 times and the previous version is gone. No backup is kept. This has destroyed real work for our whole team — affects every user who saves to a share.

comments.body: Confirmed: the save path truncates before the write completes. Needs write-to-temp-then-rename.
Also seen on NFS, so it's not SMB-specific.

title: Typo in error message: 'occured' in the export dialog
body: "An error occured while exporting" — should be 'occurred'. One-line fix in exporter.py.

title: Add CSV import to complement the exporter
body: We can export projects to CSV but not load them back. Round-tripping would let us bulk-edit in a spreadsheet.
